data.long_meaning: The name Devarth is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deva' meaning 'God' and 'Arth' meaning 'Sense'. It symbolizes the divine sense or understanding of the universe and one's place in it. This name is revered in Hindu mythology for those who aspire to live a life rooted in spiritual awareness and divine connection. The name Devarth carries the meaning “Godlike, Divine” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devarth usually hope their child will grow to embody godlike, divine and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Devartha Maharaja, also known as Devavarma, was a ruler of the Eastern Ganga Dynasty in Odisha, India. He ruled from 1270 to 1290 CE. During his reign, he expanded his kingdom and brought peace and prosperity to his subjects.

Devartha, also known as Devabhatta or Devaraja, was a ruler of the Hoysala Empire in Karnataka, India. He ruled from 1173 to 1197 CE. His reign was marked by military conquests and architectural achievements, including the construction of the Hoysaleswara Temple at Halebidu.
